outing.hero_prompt_english: Haotian Park in Liangxiang Fangshan: the recognizable five-story octagonal brick Liangxiang pagoda with restrained close-spaced eaves on a modest low mound, framed by gold and green trees and a formal park path. An adult photographs it from ground level. Accurate five-level brick silhouette, no invented giant tower or inaccessible climbing. Original peaceful full-bleed vertical artwork, layered filled background. No text, letters, logos, copied artwork, or invented maps. Adults in opaque everyday clothes only if people appear.
